alabama.housing: 100% disabled veterans can get a full property-tax exemption; partial relief exists at lower ratings. Confirm with the county.
alabama.tax: No state tax on military retirement pay or SBP.
alabama.school: Alabama GI Dependent Scholarship for children of disabled, deceased, or certain POW/MIA veterans.
alabama.work: Veterans' preference on state jobs. County VSOs file claims for free.
alabama.recreation: Free hunting/fishing licenses and park entry are commonly available at 100% disabled.

alaska.housing: Disabled veterans rated 50%+ can exempt a large share of home value (often cited up to $150,000).
alaska.school: Education benefits through University of Alaska and the state veterans office.
alaska.recreation: Reduced hunting/fishing fees; Marine Highway discounts for some disabled vets.

arizona.housing: Property-tax reduction for qualifying disabled veterans. Check the county assessor.
arizona.tax: Military retirement pay is exempt from Arizona income tax.
arizona.school: Reduced tuition pathways at state universities.
arizona.work: Veteran preference and a statewide VSO network.
arizona.recreation: Free licenses and an annual state-park pass are typical at 100% disabled.

arkansas.housing: Homestead exemption for veterans who are 100% disabled or unemployable.
arkansas.school: Free tuition at state schools for dependents of deceased or 100% disabled veterans.
arkansas.work: State hiring preference. Military Family Relief Fund.
arkansas.recreation: Free licenses and park admission commonly at 100% disabled.

california.housing: Disabled Veterans' Exemption on property tax (indexed each year). CalVet home loans are separate.
california.tax: Partial subtraction for military retired pay with AGI limits. Confirm FTB.
california.school: College Fee Waiver for dependents of disabled or deceased veterans at UC, CSU, and community colleges.
california.work: CalVet and EDD veteran employment programs.
california.recreation: Disabled Veteran Pass for state parks.
california.help: calvet.ca.gov or a County Veterans Service Office

colorado.housing: Property-tax exemption for qualifying 100% disabled veteran homeowners.
colorado.tax: Partial treatment of military retirement. Confirm DOR.
colorado.school: Tuition assistance and dependent programs through CDVA.
colorado.work: A veterans service officer in every county.
colorado.recreation: Free licenses and Centennial park pass at higher ratings.

connecticut.housing: Local property-tax exemptions for veterans; larger amounts if disabled.
connecticut.school: Tuition waiver at state colleges for qualifying veterans and some dependents.
connecticut.work: Ask CT DVA about wartime service bonuses if you never claimed one.

delaware.housing: School-tax relief for older long-time resident veterans.
delaware.tax: Confirm Division of Revenue rules for military retirement.
delaware.school: Education benefits for children of deceased veterans.
delaware.work: Veteran tax credits and state hiring preference.
delaware.recreation: Free licenses and an annual park pass at higher ratings.

florida.housing: See the full Florida page: $5,000 exemption at 10%+, full homestead at 100% P&T.
florida.school: Out-of-state tuition waiver if you reside in Florida while enrolled.
florida.recreation: Free lifetime state-park family pass for service-connected disabled veterans.

georgia.housing: Homestead exemption for 100% disabled veterans. Cap is indexed. File with the county.
georgia.tax: Partial exclusion for military retirement. Confirm Georgia DOR.
georgia.school: State aid and dependent education programs through GDVS.
georgia.recreation: Free licenses and ParkPass at 100% disabled.

hawaii.housing: Property-tax exemption for 100% disabled veteran homeowners.
hawaii.school: Reduced University of Hawaii tuition in some cases.
hawaii.recreation: Reduced park fees for disabled veterans.

idaho.housing: Property-tax reduction for qualifying disabled veterans.
idaho.tax: Partial subtraction for military retirement. Confirm Tax Commission.
idaho.recreation: License and park discounts for disabled veterans.

illinois.housing: Disabled-veteran homestead exemption; full exemption commonly tied to a 70%+ rating.
illinois.school: Illinois Veteran Grant can cover tuition at state schools.
illinois.work: Ask IDVA about GWOT bonus windows and the MIA/POW scholarship.

indiana.housing: Property-tax deductions for disabled veterans and surviving spouses.
indiana.tax: Military retirement is generally exempt. Confirm DOR.
indiana.school: Tuition and fee exemptions for certain veterans and dependents.
indiana.recreation: Free licenses at 100% disabled; Golden Hoosier park pass.

iowa.housing: Homestead credit for veterans. Amount is set by law.

kansas.school: Tuition waiver for dependents of POW/MIA/KIA in many cases.

kentucky.tax: Partial treatment of military retirement. Confirm KY DOR.
kentucky.school: Tuition waiver for dependents of deceased or 100% disabled veterans.

louisiana.housing: Disabled-veteran homestead exemption on top of the regular homestead.
louisiana.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

maine.housing: Property-tax exemption for veterans; larger amounts if disabled.
maine.school: Tuition waiver for dependents of certain veterans.
maine.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

maryland.tax: Partial subtraction for military retirement with income rules. Confirm Comptroller.
maryland.school: Edward T. Conroy and other dependent scholarships.
maryland.recreation: Free licenses and annual park pass at 100% disabled.

massachusetts.housing: Clause 22 property-tax exemptions. Amounts vary by town and disability.
massachusetts.school: Tuition waiver at state colleges for qualifying veterans.
massachusetts.work: Welcome Home Bonus if unclaimed. Chapter 115 aid through local Veterans' Service Officers.
massachusetts.help: Every city/town has a Veterans' Service Officer

michigan.housing: Property-tax exemption for 100% disabled veterans on a qualifying homestead.
michigan.school: State tuition grants and Guard programs through MVAA.
michigan.recreation: Free licenses and Recreation Passport at 100% disabled.

minnesota.housing: Market-value exclusion on the homestead of a qualifying disabled veteran.
minnesota.work: County VSOs and the Assistance Council for Veterans.
minnesota.recreation: Free licenses and state-park permit at 100% disabled.

mississippi.housing: Ad valorem exemption for 100% disabled veterans on a qualifying home.
mississippi.school: Scholarship programs for children of eligible veterans.

missouri.school: Tuition and fee waivers at state schools for qualifying veterans.
missouri.recreation: Free licenses and parks at higher ratings.

montana.housing: Property-tax relief for disabled veterans, county administered.
montana.tax: Partial treatment of military retirement. Confirm DOR.
montana.recreation: License and park discounts for disabled veterans.

nebraska.tax: Military retirement pay is fully exempt.
nebraska.work: State veterans homes and cemetery system.
nebraska.recreation: Free licenses and park permit at 100% disabled.

nevada.housing: Disabled-veteran property-tax exemption. County assessor administers it.
nevada.school: Fee waivers through NDVS and NSHE.

new-hampshire.housing: See the full New Hampshire page for town-set tax credits.
new-hampshire.tax: No state income tax on wages or military retirement.
new-hampshire.school: Free tuition pathways for children of 100% disabled or deceased wartime veterans.
new-hampshire.work: Veterans' hiring preference on public jobs.
new-hampshire.recreation: Free lifetime hunting/fishing license at 100% P&T.

new-jersey.office_name: New Jersey Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
new-jersey.housing: Full property-tax exemption on a principal residence for many 100% disabled veterans.
new-jersey.school: Tuition waiver at state schools for qualifying dependents.
new-jersey.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

new-mexico.office_name: New Mexico Department of Veterans' Services
new-mexico.housing: Property-tax exemption for veterans; larger if disabled.
new-mexico.school: In-state tuition and some fee waivers for qualifying veterans.

new-york.office_name: New York State Division of Veterans' Services
new-york.housing: Veterans' alternative exemption plus a disabled-veteran exemption. Many towns set the amount.
new-york.school: NYS Veterans Tuition Awards and MERIT pathways.
new-york.work: Ask about wartime bonuses if unclaimed.
new-york.recreation: Free licenses; vehicle park pass at mid-range ratings.

north-carolina.office_name: N.C. Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
north-carolina.housing: First slice of home value (commonly $45,000) can be exempt for 100% disabled veterans.
north-carolina.school: Scholarships for children of certain disabled, deceased, or POW/MIA veterans.
north-carolina.recreation: Free licenses at 50%+; free parks at 100% disabled.

north-dakota.office_name: North Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
north-dakota.tax: Military retirement is not given extra tax. Confirm Tax Commissioner.
north-dakota.work: Ask ND DVA about GWOT bonus history.

ohio.school: Ohio War Orphans and Severely Disabled Veterans' Children Scholarship.
ohio.work: Every county has a Veterans Service Commission.

oklahoma.housing: Ad valorem exemption for 100% disabled veterans.
oklahoma.school: Tuition waivers for dependents of eligible veterans.
oklahoma.recreation: Free licenses and an annual park pass for many disabled veterans.

oregon.housing: Disabled-veteran property-tax exemption. ODVA also runs home-loan programs.
oregon.tax: Partial subtraction for military retirement. Confirm DOR.

pennsylvania.housing: Exemption or rebate programs for 100% disabled veterans.
pennsylvania.school: Educational Assistance Program for National Guard and dependents.
pennsylvania.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

rhode-island.office_name: Rhode Island Office of Veterans Services
rhode-island.tax: Military retirement is generally exempt. Confirm Division of Taxation.
rhode-island.work: Office of Veterans Services claims help.
rhode-island.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

south-carolina.office_name: South Carolina Department of Veterans' Affairs
south-carolina.school: Free tuition for dependents of certain deceased or disabled veterans.

south-dakota.office_name: South Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
south-dakota.school: Tuition reduction at public schools for qualifying veterans.
south-dakota.recreation: Free licenses and annual park pass at 100% disabled.

tennessee.housing: Property-tax relief for disabled veterans and surviving spouses. Income rules apply.
tennessee.tax: No state income tax on wages or military retirement.
tennessee.work: TDVS field offices in every region.
tennessee.recreation: Free licenses at 30%+ in many cases; park pass at 100% disabled.

texas.housing: Full homestead exemption at 100% disabled. Partial exemptions at lower ratings.
texas.school: Hazlewood Act — tuition and fees at public colleges for qualifying veterans and often one child.
texas.work: Free TVC claims representation. Veterans Land Board loans.
texas.recreation: Free licenses at 50%+; state-park pass at higher ratings.

utah.office_name: Utah Department of Veterans and Military Affairs
utah.housing: Property-tax abatement for disabled veterans, administered locally.
utah.tax: Military retirement goes through Utah's retirement tax-credit system. Confirm Tax Commission.

vermont.housing: Property-tax exemption or reduction for disabled veterans.
vermont.tax: Military retirement exemption is income-tiered in recent years. Confirm Tax Department.
vermont.work: Vermont Veterans Home and OVA counselors.
vermont.recreation: Free licenses at 50%+; free day-use state parks for veterans.

virginia.housing: Local property-tax exemption for 100% disabled veterans on a qualifying home.
virginia.tax: Military-retirement subtraction with no age gate as of 2025+. Confirm Virginia TAX.
virginia.school: VMSDEP for spouses and children of killed or 100% disabled veterans.
virginia.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 100% disabled.

washington.office_name: Washington State Department of Veterans Affairs
washington.housing: Property-tax exemption or deferral for disabled veterans. Some tracks have income tests.
washington.school: Tuition waivers at public colleges for qualifying veterans and some dependents.
washington.recreation: Disabled-veteran Discover Pass and license discounts.

west-virginia.office_name: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance
west-virginia.work: State veterans home and DVA offices.
west-virginia.recreation: Free licenses and parks at higher ratings.

wisconsin.housing: Property-tax credit for veterans in many cases.
wisconsin.school: Wisconsin GI Bill tuition remission at UW and technical colleges.
wisconsin.work: Veterans Trust Fund grants. County VSOs.
wisconsin.recreation: Free licenses and parks at 70%+ disabled.

wyoming.school: Wyoming veterans tuition programs at community colleges and the university.
wyoming.work: Veterans Commission and county service officers.
